identity.name: Biology of Sport
identity.publisher: Termedia Publishing House, on behalf of the Institute of Sport - National Research Institute (Poland)

encoding_notes: Live page loaded cleanly via WebFetch (Tier A) — no archive/block used; source_note null.

Article types: guide accepts 'original research articles, short communications and review papers'. Mapped original->original_research, review papers->review. 'Short communications' (2000-word cap) has no clean enum slot and was OMITTED.
Figures+tables COMBINED cap = 8 ('figures and tables, counted together, should not exceed 8') — cannot be expressed as separate figures_max/tables_max; left both null. See schema_gaps.
references_max=40 applies ONLY to original papers ('40 references for original papers'); global references.max_count left null and per-type cap encoded in word_limits.original_research.

References: 'List all authors' — no et al. truncation, so et_al_threshold=null. NLM format, journal names abbreviated (example 'Biol Sport'). DOI optional ('a database's unique identifier could be added'), not required.

double_blind set true: system 'will automatically compose a file that will serve as a blind copy for reviewers and should not contain elements allowing identification of authors' — review copy is author-anonymized. Guide does not literally say 'double-blind'; separate title-page file + author-blinded main file are required, so blinding fields set to enforce scrubbing.
Abstract: 'no more than 250 words, including objectives, methods, results and conclusions' — content guidance, not labeled sub-headings; encoded as unstructured (structured=false).

Figure formats: guide lists 'bitmap formats (TIFF, GIF, JPEG, etc.)'. GIF has no allowed enum slot; encoded tiff+jpeg only. min_dpi 300 ('at least 300 dpi unless intentionally lower for scientific reasons').
Figure legends location unstated (only 'titles and legends ... self-explanatory'); left null. Tables 'on separate sheets' -> placement grouped_end (best fit).

page_size unstated; margins given in cm (2.5 cm all sides) suggest A4 but not explicitly stated, so page_size=null. line_numbers, page_numbers, running_head-on-page, alignment, first_line_indent all unstated.
Keywords: 'up to 6 key words (preferably ... MeSH terms)'; max=6, case/separator unstated.
Cover letter required: 'A cover letter (authors' statement) must be signed by all authors.'
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.

2026-07-22 et-al doctrine audit: et_al_threshold null -> 'all' — this guide EXPLICITLY requires every author to be listed (statement quoted in the notes above); null now means guide-silent and falls back to the citation style's default.
